entities.name: Coin Empire
entities.description: Ancient civilization of gray-skinned horned giants that spanned many planes, then vanished with little trace.

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: Loxodon planeswalker who named the Coin Empire and studied it.

entities.name: Ir
entities.description: Plane the Fomori are native to, on Turri Island.

entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: Ixalan civilization that fought the Coin Empire.

entities.name: Chimil
entities.description: Inner sun of Ixalan caged by the Coin Empire, who later destroyed its prison.

entities.name: The Night War
entities.description: 320-year war against the Coin Empire on Ixalan.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Fought by the Fomori and Drix in the Edge.

entities.name: Drix
entities.description: Allies of the Fomori against the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: Aware of the empire; shared what she knew with Jace.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who sought a living child tied to the Empire.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: Contacted Quint about evidence beneath Orazca.

entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: Coin Empire vault on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Fae planeswalker used by Jace to assemble a team.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion used as a timeline marker.

events.summary: The Coin Empire invades Ixalan's Core, turns on the Oltec and cages Chimil in an assembly of ships.
events.quote: eventually caging the inner sun Chimil within an assembly of their invasion ships

events.summary: After a 320-year Night War, Chimil destroys its prison.
The Coin Empire disappears from history for unknown reasons.
events.quote: the Coin Empire seems to have disappeared from history

events.summary: Tamiyo meets Jace in Ravnica and shares what she knew of the empire.
events.quote: Tamiyo met Jace Beleren in Ravnica

events.summary: Quintorius Kand rediscovers evidence of the empire in coin motifs.
events.quote: evidence of the empire was rediscovered by planeswalker Quintorius Kand

events.summary: Saheeli tells Quint of evidence beneath Orazca; he joins the expedition to the Core and meets the Oltec.
events.quote: Quint joined the expedition to the Core of Ixalan

events.summary: At Colony's End Quint finds a Giant in stasis that moves, and flees.
events.quote: it suddenly moved when Quint approached it

events.summary: Jace, with Vraska and disguised as Ashiok, uses Oko to assemble a team to break into Maag Taranau, wakes the child in stasis and leaves with it.
events.quote: Jace and Vraska left the other members of the team and disappeared with the child

events.summary: On Arcavios Quint finds evidence of the Fomori fighting the Eldrazi.
events.quote: depictions of the fight against the Eldrazi

relations.quote: waged The Night War against the Coin Empire

relations.note: Gave it the name Coin Empire
relations.quote: given to them by the planeswalker Quintorius Kand
